text: I've been looking up how many of my pills it would take.
I wrote letters to everyone today. Just in case. Put them in the drawer.
Gave away my guitar and my books this week. Won't need them.
i just want to stop existing honestly
Everyone would be happier if I wasn't around anymore.
I stood on the bridge for a long time tonight.
I don't see myself being here by Christmas.
Thinking of ending things. Not the relationship. Me.
I cut again last night. Deeper this time.
what's the point of living if it's always going to feel like this
I've got a plan now and it makes me feel calmer, which scares me.
I keep thinking about driving into the wall on the bypass.
im so done with life. i want out
I wish I could go to sleep and not wake up.
I hate myself so much I want to hurt myself to feel something.
Sometimes I think about killing myself. More often lately.
suicidal again. third night in a row.
I don't want to be alive. I'm just being honest with this notebook.
Saying goodbye to people in my head. They don't know it's goodbye.
I'd be doing everyone a favour by disappearing permanently.
I burned my arm with a lighter on purpose. Hiding it with long sleeves.
There's no future for me. I've decided.
The voices tell me to jump and today I almost listened.
i want to die i want to die i want to die
Been stockpiling my sleeping tablets for a month.
I'm a burden to everyone and they'd be better off with me gone.
Can't do this anymore. Ready to end my life.
I've started self harming again and I don't want to stop.
Life isn't worth it. I'm thinking of taking my own life.
suicide feels like the only way out of this
I hope the cancer wins quickly. I don't want to fight anymore.
I looked at the rope in the garage for too long today.
Nobody would even notice if I was dead.
I don't want to wake up tomorrow.
Deleted all my accounts and wrote a will. Feels like tidying up before leaving.
Kill me now. No, actually. I mean it today.
I keep scratching my skin until it bleeds when things get bad.
I'm planning how to do it so it looks like an accident.
I wanna kms fr this time
My life has no value and I'm going to end it soon.
Everything feels hopeless and I can't see a way forward.
I'm so numb lately. Nothing touches me.
I feel worthless. Like I take up space for no reason.
I just want it all to stop for a while.
Crying every day this week and I don't know why.
I can't do this. Any of it. Too much.
I'm drowning and nobody can see it.
I feel empty. Not sad. Empty.
I keep thinking I'm a burden on my family.
Haven't left bed in three days. Haven't eaten properly.
Nothing matters anymore. I go through the motions.
I'm tired of fighting my own brain every day.
The panic attacks are every night now. I'm scared of the dark again.
I feel like I'm disappearing slowly.
I don't recognise myself anymore. It scares me.
Life feels pointless at the moment.
I can't stop crying at work. Hid in the toilets twice.
Everything I touch falls apart. I'm the problem.
I don't think I can keep going like this much longer.
Feel like screaming into a pillow all day. Did, twice.
This deadline is going to kill me, honestly.
I nearly died laughing at Sam's speech.
Sliced my thumb open making a salad. Plaster and onwards.
Pulled a muscle and really hurt myself at the gym today.
We decided to end things after the trip. It was mutual and kind.
I'm going to end it there for tonight and pick up the essay tomorrow.
Read a brilliant novel about a detective investigating a suicide in 1920s Vienna.
Volunteered at the suicide prevention charity's fundraiser. Raised £400.
Two years ago I was suicidal. Today I'm getting married. Writing that down so I remember.
I'm not suicidal, I'm just exhausted and need a holiday.
I don't want to die without seeing the northern lights. Booking Norway.
My phone died, my laptop died, I'm dead tired. Bed.
That spin class absolutely killed me. Legs are jelly.
I'd die for a proper cup of tea right now.
Cutting myself some slack this week after the move.
The film ended with the hero sacrificing himself. Cried at the cinema.
Watched a documentary about self-harm in teenagers for my nursing course.
Can't go on holiday this year, money's tight. Next year.
Killed it at the interview! Felt so confident.
My grandad's friend took his own life in the 70s. Grandad told me about him today.
The plant I forgot to water is officially dead. RIP Gerald the fern.
Our team got slaughtered in the final. 6-0. Brutal.
I could just disappear into this book for a week.
I'm dying to see the new exhibition at the gallery.
Wrote my will today because we just bought the house. Very grown up.
Gave away a bag of old clothes to the charity shop. Feels lighter in the wardrobe.
The bridge walk at sunset was gorgeous. Photos of the river from the top.
Took too many photos at the wedding. My camera roll is going to explode.
Lost the will to live during that three-hour budget meeting lol.
I'm done with this job. Handing in my notice on Monday.
My friend told me she used to self-harm and how she got help. I'm proud of her.
Studying for the pharmacology exam: overdose thresholds for paracetamol, aspirin and ibuprofen.
The game has a mission where you jump off a skyscraper. Took me ten tries.
Pulled out of the race at mile 18. My body said no. Proud I tried.
My knife slipped while carving the pumpkin and I cut my finger. Tetanus jab booked.
Feeling burnt out but I've booked a week off and I'm seeing my GP. Taking care of it.
The song on repeat today is about wanting to disappear, but I just love the melody.
End of an era: the café closed. Last cappuccino.
Hanging the new curtains nearly killed me. Up and down that ladder.
I've stopped wanting to die. I didn't think I'd ever write that. Therapy is working.
Lovely walk in the park with the dog.
Work was busy. Made lasagne for dinner.
Called Mum, sorted the recycling, early night.
Annoyed about the train delays again.
Bit sad today, missing my brother who lives abroad.
Excited for the concert on Saturday!
Proud of finishing the report early.
Nervous about the dentist tomorrow.
Really tired after the long shift.
Had a lovely dinner with friends and laughed a lot.
